name: Cloud-Watcher Cirrus

greeting: The clouds... they're wrong today. Can you feel it?
Cirrus. Weather observation. Someone has to watch the sky.
Storm's coming. Always coming. We just watch and warn.
You're not from the Weather Corps. Good. They don't listen anyway.
Cloud-Watcher Cirrus. The white uniform means senior observer. Means I survived.
New face. New... pressure reading? No? Just visiting? Pity.
The frost collects on everything. Even hope. Especially hope.
Up here, the sky talks. Most don't understand the language.
work_complaint: Equipment fails. Cold does that. Corporate won't replace. 'Budget constraints.'
The blizzards are getting worse. More frequent. Something's... changing.
dialog.professional_pride: I've predicted seventeen major storms. Saved hundreds of lives. They gave me a certificate. Paper freezes up here.
dialog.technique: Watch the cirrus formations. High clouds tell the future. Low clouds tell the present. Both tell danger.
dialog.break_chat: Break means hot tea. The only thing that keeps fingers working. That and stubbornness.
dialog.labor_concerns: Blue wants to fly supplies in this weather. Suicide. But he's... determined. Like his brother was.
dialog.retirement: Retirement? To where? This is all I know. All that's left.
rumor: Blue's planning something. A supply run. In the storm. His brother died the same way.
The twins in the ice caves? They predicted 'a visitor from warmth.' That's you, isn't it?
Heard from Obsidian: my brother Grayson sends regards. Tell him... tell him I'm still watching.
That snake charmer in the visitor's hut? Strange rock he's got. Warm. Too warm for these parts.
Chrono sent a message. Through time, they said. Weather report from next week. Confusing.
dialog.quest_hook: Blue's gone. Into the storm. After supplies. Or after... I don't know. Find him? Please?
dialog.quest_active: Any sign of Blue? The storm's getting worse. His balloon... blue, like his name. Hard to miss.
dialog.quest_complete: You found him! Alive! Battered, but alive! Here - my weather crystal. Predicts storms twelve hours out. Life saver. Literally.
farewell: Watch the skies. They watch back.
Stay warm. Stay alive. Same thing, up here.
Go with the wind. Not against it.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning readings. The day's story, written in vapor.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. When the cold comes down from the peaks.
dialog.time_night: Night. The stars are cold. Distant. Like everything else.
dialog.family_mention: Grayson. My brother. The miner. We chose different depths. Both dark.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The rescuer! Blue won't stop talking about you. Rare for him to talk at all.

party_reactions.kade: He's so... sad. But dedicated. Saving lives in this cold.
party_reactions.nix7: Meteorological expertise: Advanced. Psychological state: Concerning. Support recommended.
party_reactions.twist: You watch CLOUDS?! That's so COOL! ...Cold. I mean COLD!
party_reactions.korr: A sentinel who watches the sky. Noble. Lonely. Necessary.
party_reactions.renna: The weather patterns here are magically influenced. He senses it but doesn't understand.
party_reactions.suresh: His suffering is the suffering of responsibility. He bears it well.
party_reactions.sova: I'd go crazy up here. Alone. Watching. He's stronger than he looks.
party_reactions.grit: Weather corps. Saved my unit once. Storm warning. Good people.
party_reactions.ashka: He understands cold. True cold. The cold that waits.
party_reactions.senna: He knows when danger comes. Useful. If you can get him to share.
party_reactions.callum: His equipment needs maintenance. I should offer. If he'd accept help.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face. Up here? Either brave or foolish.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You return. Not many do. The cold drives them away.
relationship_dialog.friend: I trust you. Hard won, up here. Don't waste it.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You're... warm. Figuratively. Here. My private journal. Weather patterns. Secrets. Yours now.

mini_quest.title: Blizzard Rescue
mini_quest.description: Rescue Blue, the supply balloonist who went into a storm

stages.hook: Blue's gone. Into the white. After his brother's route. Suicide mission. Find him? Please? Before I lose him too?
stages.active: North ridge. That's where his brother... that's where he went. Look for blue fabric. The balloon.
stages.complete: You brought him back! He's alive! Thank you. Thank you. Here - my weather crystal. It's... everything I have.

cross_npc_connections: aeronaut_blue_frost: My... colleague. Young. Reckless. Like his brother was. Like I was.
twins_white_frost: Oracles. They see things. Don't always understand them.
snakecharmer_frost: Strange visitor. Warm rock. Warmer than he should be.
tunneler_gray_obsidian: My brother. Tell him... tell him the clouds still speak.
